ext_description.message: Instant warnings on fake NFT mint and airdrop claim pages. All checks run locally.

warning_title.message: This site is probably a wallet drainer

warning_proceed.message: I understand the risk, continue anyway

warning_note.message: Real projects host airdrop and mint flows on their official domain or on an address announced from their official X/Discord accounts. Do not trust "claim" links from X replies or DMs. Wallet connection and signature requests on this page can drain your funds.

popup_allow.message: I trust this site (add to allowlist)

overlay_title.message: Web3 Phish Guard: this site looks suspicious (risk $1/100)

overlay_hint.message: Verify the address on the project's official X/Discord before connecting your wallet or signing anything.

opt_x_help.message: Optional. With an Xquik API key (xquik.com) the extension looks up the project's official X account for a suspicious domain and the account that shared the link. Only the project name or handle is sent, never the page you visit. Roughly 20 credits per new project name, cached for 7 days.

opt_test_fail.message: No result. Check the key and your credits.

sig_user_allow.message: You marked this domain as trusted

sig_ip_host.message: IP address instead of a domain name

sig_allowlist.message: On a known safe list (MetaMask allowlist)

sig_brand_impersonation.message: Carries the "$1" name but is not its official domain ($2)

sig_brand_unverified.message: Carries the "$1" project name; its official domain is not verified yet

sig_action_hyphen.message: Bait word + project name pattern (e.g. claim-project)

sig_poster_mismatch.message: Posted by $1, not the project's official account $2

sig_poster_reply.message: Shared as a reply (fake claim link under an official announcement pattern)

sig_display_mismatch.message: The address shown on X ($1) differs from the one opened

sig_combo.message: Brand + bait word + new/shared hosting combination

sig_auto_connect.message: Requested a wallet connection on page load without any click

sig_chain_switch.message: Network switch requested without a click

sig_tx_set_approval_for_all.message: Dangerous transaction: setApprovalForAll (access to all your NFTs)

sig_tx_permit.message: Dangerous transaction: Permit / Permit2 (token transfer authority)

sig_tx_payable_unknown.message: Unknown contract call that sends ETH (fake claim/mint pattern)

sig_sign_typed.message: Dangerous signature: $1 typed data (token/NFT transfer authority)

sig_sign_eth_sign.message: Dangerous signature: eth_sign (raw signature, can authorize anything)

sig_x_domain_match.message: The project's X account $1 links to this domain

sig_x_domain_mismatch.message: The project's X account $1 links to $2, not to this domain

sig_x_poster_weak.message: Sharing account $1 is weak: $2 followers, $3 days old
